effect.minecraft.absorption.description: Adds temporary hearts that absorb damage and do not regenerate.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.description: Can become Raid Omen in a village or Trial Omen near a trial spawner.
effect.minecraft.blindness.description: Darkens vision and prevents sprinting and critical hits.
effect.minecraft.conduit_power.descripti: Improves underwater sight and mining speed, and prevents drowning.
effect.minecraft.darkness.description: Darkens vision with a pulsing fog.
effect.minecraft.dolphins_grace.descript: Greatly increases movement speed in water.
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.descrip: Protects against damage from fire and lava.
effect.minecraft.glowing.description: Outlines affected entities so they can be seen through blocks.
effect.minecraft.haste.description: Speeds up block breaking and attacks.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Villagers offer trade discounts and may give gifts.
effect.minecraft.hunger.description: Uses up the food bar faster.
effect.minecraft.infested.description: May spawn silverfish when the affected entity takes damage.
effect.minecraft.instant_damage.descript: Hurts living targets but heals undead ones.
effect.minecraft.instant_health.descript: Heals living targets but hurts undead ones.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.descriptio: Hides the affected entity and shortens mob detection range; held and worn items remain visible.
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.description: Increases jump height and reduces fall damage.
effect.minecraft.levitation.description: Lifts the affected entity into the air.
effect.minecraft.luck.description: Raises the luck value used by loot tables that account for it.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.descriptio: Makes dark areas and underwater spaces easier to see.
effect.minecraft.oozing.description: Attempts to spawn slimes when the affected entity dies.
effect.minecraft.poison.description: Deals damage over time without delivering the final blow.
effect.minecraft.raid_omen.description: Starts a raid where the effect was gained if its timer expires.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.descriptio: Slows descent and prevents fall damage.
effect.minecraft.trial_omen.description: Allows eligible trial spawners nearby to become ominous.
effect.minecraft.unluck.description: Lowers the luck value used by loot tables that account for it.
effect.minecraft.weaving.description: Spreads cobwebs on death and allows faster movement through them.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.descriptio: Releases a burst of wind when the affected entity dies.
effect.minecraft.wither.description: Deals potentially fatal damage over time.
